title: Safety Gym
summary: We’re releasing Safety Gym, a suite of environments and tools for measuring progress towards reinforcement learning agents that respect safety constraints while training.
body: We’re releasing Safety Gym, a suite of environments and tools for measuring progress towards reinforcement learning agents that respect safety constraints while training.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了Safety Gym，这是一个环境与工具套件，专门用于测量强化学习智能体在满足安全约束条件下的训练进展，有助于解决AI在现实场景中的安全性与合规性问题。原始信息显示：We’re releasing Safety Gym, a suite of environments and tools for measuring progress towards reinforcement learning agents that respect safety constraints while training.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Safety Gym”。其重要性主要体现在：推出了Safety Gym工具套件，用以评估和度量强化学习智能体在训练中的安全性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
